value.message: Detect and manage how to respond to sensitive content, such as employee personal issues, in conversational experiences with generative AI.
Detect and manage how to respond to sensitive content, such as employee personal issues, in conversational experiences with generative AI.
Start activating filters from the Available tab.

Sample phrases are examples of the types of text the filter should detect. They help train the system to recognize similar text in user inputs. Providing accurate and representative examples is crucial for effective detection.

While there is no strict rule, providing at least 25 diverse examples can help improve the accuracy of the detection system. More examples can further enhance the system's ability to identify variations of sensitive text.
Ensure that the sample phrases are accurate and representative of the sensitive text you want to detect.
Deactivating filters will turn off logging and redirection for filtered subjects.
